propositions: A focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must independently evaluate each direct dependency without injecting prerequisite material into general reviewers or changing existing parent/child review behavior.

Prerequisite finder, verifier, and verifier-split recovery must operate on stable lexicographically-ordered PrerequisiteBlock bins and PrerequisiteVerificationBlock records, never splitting subject or prerequisite plan text.

Every readable pinned prerequisite must receive exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent|finding|indeterminate) with a reason code; missing, duplicate, or invalid output maps to output-invalid; context-limit failure maps to evaluation-error with detail=input-too-large.

General and focused verification index domains must be reshaped independently before concatenation; missing or incorrect prerequisite attribution converts that record to indeterminate/attribution-invalid and removes its incompatibility findings.
Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict even when DET blockers are retained in the blocking array and marked via coverage flag.

Prerequisite-scoped findings use structured four-field UTF-8 length-prefixed identity encoding (version, finding text, criteria, canonical ID) with SHA-256 hash; non-prerequisite findings retain existing pipe-delimited encoding unchanged.
